issue.detail: Spec does not define output during reset or whether z is registered vs combinational; contract asserts z=0 during reset and combinational same-cycle output.
issue.spec_evidence: The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted.
issue.alternative: Output z may be registered (visible next cycle) and hold last value during reset rather than forced 0.

issue.detail: Spec says conversion begins when Reset is released; contract has no explicit rule for first-cycle behavior after release, and R5 example row3 expects z=0 for x=0 which matches R1 but not stated.
issue.spec_evidence: The conversion begins when Reset is released and stops when Reset is asserted.
issue.alternative: First cycle after reset release may be a don't-care or may output x directly; alternative treats first released cycle as S0 pass-through.
